description: Search the live 199.domains inventory of brandable and keyword domain names for sale at fixed prices ($29 to $199). Pass what the person is building (e.g. 'ai sales agent', 'fitness app', 'stock trading', 'developer tool') and optional filters. Returns real listings only, each with its price, total with fee and buy URL. It never suggests names to register elsewhere.

collection.description: Only names in this collection slug (see list_collections), e.g. 'ai-agent-domains'.

max_price.description: Maximum price in USD (listings range from $29 to $199).

query.description: Keywords, industry, product idea or naming style (e.g. 'short brandable', 'one word'). Empty returns featured and newest.
